log_file.description: The file where Nagios will write its internal status information.

config_dir.description: The directory containing additional configuration files.

object_cache_file.description: File where Nagios stores object definitions for faster loading.

status_file.description: File where Nagios stores current status information.

command_file.description: Named pipe used to pass commands to Nagios.

pid_file.description: File where the Nagios process ID is stored.

log_rotation_method.description: Rotation strategy: n=Nagios, w=Weekly, d=Daily, h=Hourly, m=Monthly, y=Yearly.

use_aggressive_host_checking.description: Whether to re-check hosts/services immediately after state change.

interval_length.description: Length of a minute in seconds.

check_for_updates.description: Whether to check for new Nagios versions at nagios.org.

binary_plugins_path.description: Directory where external plugins are stored.

icon_image.description: Path to the default icon image for the web interface.

icon_image_small.description: Path to the small icon image for the web interface.

statusmap_background_image.description: Path to the background image for the statusmap CGIs.

statusmap_transparency_index.description: Hex color code for transparency in the statusmap.

check_external_commands.description: Whether to allow checking external commands from the CGI.

external_command_interval.description: Interval between checking for external commands.

max_check_result_retrieval_age.description: How long to keep old check results in seconds.

max_concurrent_checks.description: Maximum number of service checks to run concurrently (0=unlimited).

enable_event_handlers.description: Whether to allow event handlers to run.

process_performance_data.description: Whether to process performance data for graphs.

host_perfdata_file.description: File where host performance data is written.

service_perfdata_file.description: File where service performance data is written.

retain_status_information.description: Whether to retain status information between restarts.

retain_program_status.description: Whether to retain program status between restarts.

retain_contact_information.description: Whether to retain contact information between restarts.

notification_interval.description: Interval between repeated notifications in seconds.

perfdata_host_items.description: List of host performance data items to template. Flat map of name, metric, and value template string.

perfdata_service_items.description: List of service performance data items to template. Flat map of name, metric, and value template string.
